bio: This timeless bistro is a slice of la douce France. It serves classics such as egg mayonnaise, and both the menu and excellent wine list showcase the best of what that country has to offer. Chef Robbert van Sonsbeek is a master sauce maker and treats his ingredients with respect. In a dish featuring succulent roasted farm-raised chicken, he includes the tenderloin, pairing it with pan-fried chanterelles and a refined butter sauce infused with vin jaune. From a tempting array of indulgent dishes, you can order à la carte or create your own Bib Gourmand set menu. Robbert and Heleen clearly put their heart and soul into running Bistrot Regent....
